title: Chapter 205: Cockroaches And Hydralisks As The Main Force
content:
Chapter 205: Cockroaches And Hydralisks As The Main Force

The alliance army, with nearly 300,000 troops, surrounded a small stronghold of the evil god camp with less than 10,000 people. The scene was a bit embarrassing.

"How to fight?"

An alliance lord asked Meng.

"Throw the spear first! Then hit the last knife! It's so simple, why do you still ask?"

"This is a rare opportunity. All new recruits who have never been in actual combat are required to go up and get some exercise!"

Mengpai didn't feel embarrassed, but thought it was a rare opportunity for military training.

The attack order was issued, and tens of thousands of new recruits in the alliance army, under the guidance of officers and veterans, launched an attack on the armed militia in the evil camp stronghold.

It is easy to master the basic method of throwing spears. The recruits will throw the spears one by one. Although the power of these spears is somewhat lacking, they are still decent and are very effective against the armed militiamen of the evil god camp who have no armor in the stronghold.

The Celestial Silkworm Nine Transformations Cultivation Technique is not only passed down for cultivation techniques, but also for combat skills. When recruits of the alliance army throw spears from a distance, the Celestial Silkworms in their bodies will communicate through mental power, transmitting relevant methods and skills to deepen the These new recruits understand the combat skill of spear throwing.

Linking theory with practice, progress is quite rapid.

The new recruits of the Alliance army have become very proficient in throwing spears after several rounds. The accuracy and lethality of their thrown spears have been greatly improved.

The evil god camp's armed militiamen, who numbered less than 10,000 people in the stronghold, were either killed or injured and soon lost their ability to resist.

"With the inheritance of Tiancan's Nine Transformations Technique, the army is growing so fast! In just a few battles, these new recruits will become elite soldiers!"

Seeing the terrible progress of the new recruits in the Alliance army, some Alliance lords couldn't help but sigh.

"Our army has also received the protection of the Zerg Overlord! The enemies we kill can be directly sacrificed on the battlefield just like the Zerg!"

Everyone also discovered that the enemies killed by the Alliance Army soldiers would turn into light and disappear. Wu Qing did not need to explain, they just figured it out on their own.

"I wonder if the Zerg master will be rewarded for this kind of battlefield sacrifice?"

One of the alliance lords said excitedly.

"What other rewards do you want? Lord Wu Qing and the Zerg have already given us a lot of benefits in advance!"

"Not bad! Don't be too greedy! Our first priority now is to improve our strength!"

"With our current strength, we can no longer participate in the battle of the Zerg army!"

"..."

This battle was extremely easy, and the lords of the alliance chatted together.

Meng and Hu Wei and other five major lords did not participate in this discussion. Today's battle between the Zerg army and the Bugbear clan put a lot of pressure on them.

On the battlefield, the new recruits of the Alliance Army had already thrown several rounds of spears. After they personally attacked the enemy, their whole temperament had changed.

"Stop throwing spears!"

"Switch weapons! Prepare for close combat!"

The new recruits of the alliance army picked up melee weapons, and under the leadership of the veterans, they carefully entered the stronghold and carried out last-ditch attacks on the enemies who were injured but not dead.

"Everyone, take a look at this scene! Whoever is nervous! Whoever is nervous will take the last hit!"

Because of the system's material-energy conversion, there are no corpses on the battlefield, only the wounded. The number of these wounded is not enough, so some people can only do the finishing touches themselves.

"Faster! We have to leave immediately! Keep marching!"

Most people who live in this world are used to life and death. The recruits of the Alliance Army kill people without any psychological barriers and adapt quickly.

"Keep going!"

The alliance army used some new soldiers to eliminate a stronghold of the evil god camp, and then continued to set off as a team to the next target.

They don't need to take care of the stronghold here, they are only responsible for fighting.

In this way, this alliance army trained and cleaned up all the way. It was not until they attacked a city with a large population that they became serious and showed their strong combat power.

…

Outside the area where the alliance army is responsible for sweeping, there is also the area where the Zerg puppies will sweep. The Zerg puppies will sweep eastward from the Zerg's actual control area, clearing out all remaining enemies and seizing as much territory as possible.

The mission of the Zerg flying dragon group is to attack cities with a large population of bugbears. They also want to attack all the way from west to east.

The Zerg must use powerful air power to eliminate all the war potential of the bugbears in this area and lay the foundation for the Zerg to fully control this area.

The territory occupied by the bugbears is very large, and it will take a lot of time to recover it all.

…

The Zerg reinforcements supporting the Naga tribe rested overnight in the captured demon castle. The Naga tribe sent people to send a large amount of energy coins for the Zerg army to recover and consume.

Early the next morning, Host No. 3 called Nagaron to lead the way and continued the day's battle.

The Zerg are a true fighting race. They do not need logistical supplies. They have extremely strong continuous combat and recovery capabilities and can continue to engage in high-intensity fighting and marching.

After this day, Nagaron gained a deeper understanding of the Zerg. He sorted out all the information related to the Zerg and reported it to Nagaya.

This information will eventually affect the relationship between the Nagas and the Zerg, which is of great significance.

…

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to its original form, and the Zerg army retreated first and returned to the Zerg territory.

Today, because all the main forces of the Zerg were dispatched to participate in the battle with the bugbears, the Zerg army did not enter the underground world.

Now that the war is over, the system's resources have become sufficient again, and Wu Qing wants to make full use of these resources.

Wu Qing has obtained more and more information from this world, and has a general understanding of the area where the Zerg is located. The Zerg must go out as soon as possible and move to a larger stage in order to achieve greater development.

The strength of the enemies outside may have no upper limit, and the Zerg must develop at a faster speed.

Wu Qing first built a Zerg mother nest every distance along the passage from the Zerg underground territory to the underground world, and incorporated the passage that had been expanded several times by the Zerg worker bees into the Zerg territory.

When the Zerg fungal blanket is covered, the Zerg territory extends to the large platform outside the underground world barrier, thus connecting the Zerg territory and the underground world.

Wu Qing tried to build a Zerg mother nest on the edge of the platform and found that the Zerg fungal blanket can spread normally to the underground world, which proves that the underground world does not exclude Zerg buildings.

At night, there is no weirdness in the underground world. It is equivalent to a huge territory. Therefore, Wu Qing is a little worried that the underground world will reject the Zerg buildings with the characteristics of this world's territory. Now it seems that this problem does not exist.

In this way, the Zerg finally has a foothold in the underground world, and can continue to fight with the ghouls and seize the territory of the ghouls.

As the Zerg's underground world territory expands, Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg built defense facilities for the new territory, and upgraded an anti-stealth energy air defense tower every certain distance to monitor the movements outside the Zerg territory at all times.

Wu Qing dared not relax his vigilance against the mysterious enemy. As long as the Zerg has a weakness, that guy may suddenly appear and give the Zerg a fatal blow.

Therefore, the new Zerg underground territory needs to continue to expand the space, truly connect the entire Zerg underground territory into one piece, and make sure there is no weak point in defense.

The Zerg territory is connected to the underground world as expected. Wu Qing is now going to prepare to go to the underground world to seize the Zerg army.

…

Wu Qing knew very well that if the Zerg army wanted to improve its combat power and efficiency in killing enemies, it could no longer use Zerg Zerglings as the main combat force.

The combat power of Zerg Zerglings was not weak, but when they were placed in front of the Zerg army, they affected the efficient firepower output of many arms of the Zerg army.

Moreover, the Zerg Zerglings would kill 1,000 enemies but lose 800 of their own, and they also suffered a lot of casualties.

In the past, there was no resource support, but now that there are resources, Wu Qing is ready to conquer the underground world with a more powerful Zerg army lineup.

First, the main force of the Zerg ground forces should be replaced with Zerg Cockroaches and Hydralisks. With the medium and long-range attack capabilities of these two Zerg arms, most melee troops cannot rush to them, and their melee capabilities are also very strong, so they should charge forward.

The resource consumption of Zerg Cockroaches and Hydralisks is 75 energy and 25 gas. In terms of gas resource consumption, the consumption of four Zerg Zerglings is comparable to that of a Zerg Dragon. The price is relatively low, and they can be hatched in large quantities to form a scale.

Wu Qing first hatched Zerg Hydralisks, which were 80,000 new ones, increasing the number of Hydralisks in the Zerg territory to 100,000.

Then he added 45,000 Zerg Cockroaches, increasing the number of Zerg Cockroaches in the Zerg territory to 50,000.

Two Zerg Hydralisks and one Zerg Cockroach, this is the main battle lineup Wu Qing prepared for the Zerg ground forces, and the task of the Zerg Hound is to assist them.

In the future formal battlefield, the Zerg Hound will no longer need to carry out suicidal attacks.

Wu Qing felt that this lineup was still a little insufficient in firepower to go to the underground world, so he added another 5,000 Zerg Destroyers, increasing the number of Zerg Destroyers in the Zerg territory to 10,000, more than half of which were star-level.

Wu Qing felt that it was not enough, so he increased the number of Zerg Stealth Spiders to 3,000.

The combat power of Zerg Stealth Spiders is very strong. They dive underground and cannot be hit by ordinary attacks.

Their attack method is special, which is equivalent to mobile defensive ground spikes.

The attack range of the Zerg Stealth Spider in the game is farther than that of the Zerg Hydralisk. Now in the real world, their attack range is also comparable to that of the Zerg Hydralisk, and they are very powerful ground combat troops.

When all these troops are hatched, the system resources are almost consumed.

The Zerg army that just participated in the war and withdrew has returned to the Zerg territory. They all entered the Zerg underground territory and gathered on the platform outside the underground world barrier to rest.

The newly hatched Zerg troops came to assemble one after another. With the accumulation of countless resources, a brand-new lineup of Zerg ground combat troops was born.
